incident-bot: :rotating_light: Watchdog alert triggered for rollout-service: sustained error-rate increase (5m window). Root ts 2187654321

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout-service v2 -> canary group 5% @ 12:18 UTC

Maya: seeing the incident-bot page — looking now. Error-rate spike + latency up. Not seeing the usual canary dashboard panels. grafana link in README seems stale.

Sam: I'm oncall. Maya, can you paste the specific metric name? I can't find the panel either.

Maya: metric name shown in logs: inference.errors.total and inference.latency.p95. Querying Prom: `sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) by (route)` returns a big jump for /generate.

Liam: I can't pull up the canary dashboard either — looks like the dashboard got deleted in a dashboard sync earlier today? I see an empty folder for `rollouts/canary`. :grimacing:

Anya: if dashboard panels removed, alerting rules might still exist but routing depends on dashboard metadata for runbooks. That would explain noisy pages.

Sam: Ok — immediate plan: 1) confirm customer impact 2) stop rollout if we have a kill 3) route pager accurately 4) restore visibility.

Maya: customer impact — checking support bundle and error traces. SupportBot: forward recent customer errors?

SupportBot: forwarded 12 error reports in the last 10m for customers: redwood-prod-app-1, client-x, partner-p. Basic symptom: `model selection: index-out-of-range` after v2 load path.

Liam: that aligns with stack traces pointing to model-shim v2 expecting a metadata field that isn't populated during cold start. We should stop canary.

Sam: Can someone flip the rollout kill? Where's the feature flag for this route?

Maya: flag is `model_rollout_v2` in FlagsService (prod). I can flip it. Will do a controlled flip and post commands.

Maya: running: `ffctl set prod model_rollout_v2 false --reason "emergency rollback: runtime errors+missing dashboards"`

Maya: flag set to false. Confirmed traffic back to v1 routes. 

deploy-bot: rollback observed: canary group 5% scaled back to 0% at 12:27 UTC by Maya

Sam: good. Are error rates dropping?

Maya: Prom queries show error-rate dropping but latency still elevated for a subset. Might be in-flight requests. Errors: `model-shim: missing-metadata` — heavy on client-x.

Liam: pushing a hotfix branch now to guard against missing metadata, but this needs a proper CI cycle. For now rollback is fine.

Anya: on the observability side — we need two things: 1) restore the canary dashboard panels from the dashboard backups and 2) ensure alert routing doesn't rely on dashboard existence. I'll own the dashboard restore.

Anya: quick restore steps I'm running: `grafana-cli dashboard import --id 4521 --folder "rollouts"` and then reattach panels to `rollout-service/canary` folder.

Maya: FYI the incident page in the customer SRE runbook points to dashboard URL that 404s. We're missing runbook links in alerts too. That caused delay.

Sam: Noted — will add postmortem items. For now, does anyone see lingering customer impact? SupportBot?

SupportBot: three customers reported degraded responses until 12:33 UTC. No recorded data-loss. Severity set to SEV3 per SOP but request for followup from account teams.

Sam: Thanks. Handoff: I'll own the incident until 13:00 UTC. Maya, can you follow up on the support tickets? Liam, prioritise the guard patch and open PR. Anya, finish dashboard restore and make sure alerts have runbook links.

Maya: on support. Posting a quick message to accounts.

Liam: PR opened: `fix/model-shim-guard` — CI started. Will ping when green.

Anya: dashboards restored (partial). Added runbook links to the `inference.errors.total` and `inference.latency.p95` alerts. Added a temporary alert annotation: `runbook: /runbooks/rollout-watchdog` so pages include next steps.

Sam: Good. Two follow-ups before closing: 1) why was dashboard removed? who triggered sync? 2) adjust alert routing so missing dashboard doesn't cause incorrect escalation.

Maya: quick root cause: earlier this morning a grafana sync job decommissioned dashboards under a deprecated folder during housekeeping. Filing ticket to change sync rules.

Anya: also adding a small monitoring test that runs at deploy time to verify the canary dashboard exists and alerts have runbooks — fail the deploy if missing.

Sam: Agree. I'll update the postmortem template: include customer impact timeline, who flipped flag, dashboards missing, and deploy gating test.

Maya: support update sent to customers with ETA for follow-up.

Liam: CI passed on guard patch, scheduling a patch deploy to 10% internal canary for testing. Will not proceed to external until green for 30m.

Sam: OK. Closing actions assigned: Maya (support), Liam (patch PR + canary), Anya (dashboards + alert runbooks + deploy gate), Sam (postmortem + review sync rules).

Maya: thanks — will follow up in postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident resolved: rollback successful, error-rate returned to baseline by 12:33 UTC. Incident closed at 12:40 UTC (ts 2187654860).
